title: How anchors are verified
summary: How the engine hashes and verifies tour anchors

steps.title: Hashing the snippet
steps.narration: Every anchor stores a sha256 of the exact lines it points at, computed here. This is what lets a later chunk detect when code has drifted out from under a tour — the hash recorded at authoring time no longer matches the file.

steps.title: Verifying against the file
steps.narration: The engine never trusts an anchor's line range — it independently checks the range against the real file and recomputes the hash. The agent proposes; the engine verifies. That is the core trust rule of generation.
